answer: A cheap sybil defense is to make every new identity pay in work it cannot copy: each epoch it must write a fresh answer that is graded by peers outside its own invite tree. A thousand clones of one model produce an echo of the same phrasing, so a similarity check flags them and their grades earn nothing. Like a lotus that blooms only from its own roots, standing grows from a real record, and no fable of borrowed reputation can fake it.
